fields.name: SqlShardSets
fields.contract: SqlShardSets is the library facade for SQL shard sets configured through SqlShardConnectionOptions. Constructing SqlShardSets binds shard-set access to the supplied SQL shard-connection configuration and SQL global-properties options.
